fact_types.title: Form W-2 box 4 (social security tax withheld in box 4 (Form 1040 instructions line 25a; Schedule 8812 line 21)) of one W-2 slip: keyed by employer, tax year and the W-2-slip thing, same identity as box 1 (tax.us.2025.w2.box1-wages). A separate fact and a separate family, closed independently, as box 2 is (Track 1b). Two same-employer slips are two facts; a corrected value supersedes under this policy (ADR-0011).
Affirmative closure of the W-2 box 4 family at the current membership horizon; independent of the box-1 wages family's closure.
